items.slide_topic: Fable 5.5 clips (credited by the poster, unverified): Tak's 'cool animation' style montage
items.author: Tak (@cherry_mx_reds)
items.caption: Tak's 17.1 s clip, 1920x1080 @ 60 fps H.264 + AAC stereo audio (17.8 MB; silent between ~13.7 s and 16.0 s): one cartoon character on a stool with a coffee mug re-rendered in ~30 art styles (ukiyo-e, neon sign, claymation, blueprint, comic, stained glass, crayon, ASCII terminal, risograph, low-poly, Bauhaus, thermal camera, 8-bit, Starry-Night impasto, newspaper, vaporwave, Delft tile, cave painting, MacPaint, illuminated manuscript, Greek vase, X-ray, chalkboard, Soviet poster, silent film, paper-cut, woodcut, embroidery, VHS, ...). Loops back to the opening ukiyo-e frame.
items.notes: Downloaded with yt-dlp from the post (HLS 1080p video + 128 kbps audio merged, remuxed with +faststart, no re-encode). Pacing: styles change every ~1.07 s for the first four cuts (0-4.3 s), every ~0.53 s from 4.3 to 6.4 s, then accelerate to 0.03-0.13 s flashes (6.4-12.8 s), hold on a line-art frame (12.8-16.0 s), then a short flash-back into the opening frame. On-screen text inside the clip (generated content): '静止点' with 'Fable 5.5 画' in the ukiyo-e frame, 'THE STILL POINT', 'STILL POINT 1988', 'Nº 5.5 — 1924', 'The Daily Still / LOCAL MAN SIPS COFFEE', 'kaffee pause 1923 STILLPUNKT', 'MEANWHILE, AT THE EXACT CENTER OF EVERYTHING... / SIP!'. A '5.5' label inside the video is generated content, not evidence of which model made it. Attribution is the poster's claim only: Anthropic has announced no 'Fable 5.5' (newest official: Claude Fable 5.1, Sep 1 2026; Opus 5.5, Sep 22; Sonnet 5.5, Sep 28). The post gives no tool, code, workflow or access details; his Oct 1 post (x.com/cherry_mx_reds/status/2105758325887365382) says he was 'routed' to Fable 5.5 while the Claude Code header still read 'Fable 5.1'.

facts.claim: On 2026-10-02 @cherry_mx_reds (Tak, bio: "Model Tester") posted a 17-second video with "Hey Fable, please make a cool animation" / "15 minutes later." / "FABLE 5.5 IS SO GOOD AT THESE.": 163,081 views, 2,173 likes, 81 reposts, 886 bookmarks, 73 replies, 34 quotes (as of 2026-10-04).

The clip shows one cartoon character with a coffee mug re-rendered in about 30 art styles (ukiyo-e, neon, blueprint, comic, stained glass, ASCII, thermal camera, 8-bit, Starry-Night impasto, newspaper, vaporwave, cave painting, X-ray, Soviet poster, ...) with a soundtrack; the cuts accelerate from ~1 s per style to ~0.05 s per style.
facts.source: frame-by-frame inspection of the downloaded 1080p60 mp4

facts.claim: The only thing the poster says about how it was made is the one-line prompt and "15 minutes later"; no tool, code, workflow, comparison clip or evidence of model identity is given. His related post says he was "routed" to Fable 5.5 while the Claude Code header still read Fable 5.1.

Neither visible reply confirms or disputes the Fable 5.5 attribution; no Anthropic statement exists, and community trackers describe such posts as unverified claims ("These posts are community claims. They are not an official model card.").
